name: OpenAqua
summary: Thermal management and telemetry suite for Aquacomputer devices
comment: Thermal Management and Telemetry Suite for Aqua Computer Devices
udevRule:
# Aquacomputer devices rootless access
SUBSYSTEM=="hidraw", ATTRS{idVendor}=="0c70", MODE="0666", TAG+="uaccess"

descriptionParagraphs: OpenAqua is an open-source thermal management and telemetry suite designed for Aquacomputer hardware (OCTO, QUADRO, D5 NEXT, and compatible devices).
features: Autonomous Hardware Operation: Flash custom fan curves and profiles directly to onboard device EEPROM.
Real-time telemetry monitoring for fan speeds, water flow, and thermal sensors.
Virtual temperature sensor feeding from host metrics into hardware virtual sensor slots.
Sensor calibration with custom temperature offsets.
Native low-level USB HID interface with rootless udev support.
